privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.description: How Tube O2 collects, uses, protects, and lets you control personal data used in the platform.
highlights: We collect only data needed for accounts, curation, security, and community features.
Authentication and profile data are operated with Supabase and protected by access controls.
You can request access, correction, or deletion through the contact channel.

sections.title: Data we collect
sections.body: We collect information you provide and technical data required to keep the platform secure and functional.
items: Account data such as email and authentication identifiers.
Profile data such as public name, username, bio, and avatar.
Submitted videos, playlists, favorites, comments, and editorial applications.
Basic technical signals such as language, visual preferences, session data, and security events.

sections.title: How we use data
sections.body: We use data to deliver Tube O2, organize educational content, and protect the community.
items: Authenticate users and keep sessions secure.
Display profiles, contributions, playlists, and public interactions chosen by the user.
Process submitted videos, metadata, and curation signals.
Respond to support requests, moderate abuse, and meet applicable obligations.

sections.title: Sharing and processors
sections.body: We do not sell personal data. We may use technical processors for hosting, authentication, database, email, and content enrichment.
items: Supabase for database, authentication, and backend functions.
AI and email services only when needed for content processing or communications.
YouTube/Google when you submit or view content hosted on those platforms.

sections.title: Your rights
sections.body: You can request access, correction, portability, restriction, or deletion of personal data, subject to legal and anti-abuse obligations.
items: Use the contact page for privacy-related requests.
Some public contributions may remain anonymized or aggregated when needed for editorial integrity.
We may ask for identity verification before handling sensitive requests.

terms.title: Terms of Use
terms.description: The essential rules for using Tube O2, contributing content, and participating in the community.
highlights: Use the platform respectfully, in good faith, and with editorial responsibility.
Submit only links and information you have the right to share.
We may moderate, remove, or limit content that harms the community.

sections.title: Acceptance
sections.body: By accessing or using Tube O2, you agree to these terms, the Privacy Policy, and community rules.
items: If you do not agree, do not use authenticated areas or submit content.
Some features may require an account, verification, or specific permissions.

sections.title: Allowed use
sections.body: Tube O2 exists for discovery, curation, and organization of cultural and educational videos.
items: Do not use the platform for spam, abuse, harassment, fraud, rights violations, or security bypass attempts.
Keep comments, profiles, and submissions aligned with editorial rules.
Respect copyright and the terms of linked external platforms.

sections.title: Content and contributions
sections.body: You remain responsible for the content you submit, comment on, or organize. By contributing, you authorize Tube O2 to display, classify, enrich, and organize that information within the platform.
items: We may adjust metadata, tags, and descriptions to improve curation and quality.
We may reject or remove content that violates rules, laws, or editorial criteria.
YouTube links remain subject to YouTube availability and policies.

sections.title: Availability and changes
sections.body: The platform may evolve, change, or be temporarily unavailable. We make reasonable efforts to maintain stability and clear communication.
items: Experimental features may change without prior notice.
We may update these terms when the product, risks, or legal requirements change.

cookies.title: Cookie Policy
cookies.description: How we use cookies, localStorage, and similar technologies for sessions, preferences, and experience quality.
highlights: We use essential storage for login, language, theme, and application behavior.
We do not rely on cookies to sell personal data.
You can clear cookies and local data in your browser, but this may end sessions and reset preferences.

sections.title: Technologies used
sections.body: Tube O2 may use cookies, localStorage, sessionStorage, and tokens managed by providers such as Supabase to keep the app working.
items: Authentication session and security.
Language, theme, and interface state preferences.
Local cache and technical data for performance.

sections.title: Purposes
sections.body: These technologies help authenticate users, remember preferences, and provide a faster, more consistent experience.
items: Keep you securely signed in.
Avoid asking for the same preferences repeatedly.
Support technical diagnostics and abuse prevention.

sections.title: Management
sections.body: You can block or delete cookies and local data in your browser settings.
items: Blocking essential storage may prevent login or authenticated features.
When local data is cleared, language, theme, and session may reset.
If granular consent tools are introduced later, this policy will be updated.
